name: Relapse
storyline:
Relapse is a psychological thriller game where players take on the persona of an urban blogger who decides to visit an abandoned Victorian era Insane Asylum. Unfortunately while looking for a great story to post, the player becomes the story!

Captured by Dirk, the psychopath locks the player inside the Asylum and informs the them they will be part of a little game. Escape the labyrinth of the Asylum or meet their doom at the end of a machete blade! Not a fan of a fair competition Dirk knows the layout of the asylum like the back of his hand, and our players are left stumbling through the dark.
summary: Relapse is an Amnesia inspired adventure game and psychological thriller set in a disused Victorian Insane Asylum.
